findings.message: jsonl contains operator input verbatim including potential secrets. Schema allowlist at the reader/aggregator layer is mandatory before any field reaches HTTP. Unit tests must assert content fields are absent from every JSON response.
SQLite telemetry file must be chmod 600, parent directory chmod 700, enforced via os.chmod immediately after creation. Implementation must fail-closed if it cannot set permissions.

Panel now exposes cost telemetry and session IDs. Recommend adding a local Bearer token (secrets.token_urlsafe(32), persisted to ~/.dadaia/state/panel.token chmod 600). Operator must make an explicit named decision on auth — silence is not acceptable.
Reader must enforce budget limits: max 4 MB per file per polling tick, max 64 KB per JSONL line, byte-offset checkpoint in SQLite, in-memory event buffer capped at 10,000 events per cycle.
JSONL parser must wrap each line in try/except; checkpoint must be byte-offset based. Parse failure logs must include path + offset only, never the line content.
TelemetryService must assert os.getuid() != 0 at startup and exit 1 if running as root.
Validate token count bounds: reject negative values or counts > 2,000,000; mark as suspect=True in SQLite rather than discarding. Surface UI warning banner when suspect events exist.

Add Content-Security-Policy header (default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline') to all HTML responses and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff to all JSON responses. Implement as _security_headers() method in handler.py.
Display only first 8 characters of sessionId followed by ellipsis in all list/card UI views.
Run PRAGMA integrity_check at startup; on failure rename corrupt file and boot in no-telemetry mode returning 503 from telemetry endpoints.

supply_chain_decisions.reason: Only if software-engineer demonstrates measurable contention with stdlib sqlite3 + ThreadPoolExecutor. Default: stdlib only.
Polling with os.stat is sufficient for human-timescale refresh. Native code supply-chain risk not justified.
Never. Existing regex-dispatch handler is adequate.
For auth token generation if auth is adopted.

auth_recommendation.model: local Bearer token, secrets.token_urlsafe(32), persisted to ~/.dadaia/state/panel.token chmod 600, validated in do_GET before route dispatch

decisions_required: Auth token model: adopt Bearer token (recommended) or explicit risk-acceptance decline. Must appear as a named decision in SPEC.md.
Retention cap for SQLite aggregates: perpetual (Phase 1 default) or explicit maximum size/age.
Suspect event handling (T7): mark + UI warning (recommended) or silent discard.

open_issues.issue: Confirm WAL mode (PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL) is enabled in TelemetryService constructor.
Confirm Codex SQLite opened with ?mode=ro URI flag.
Confirm log output never includes JSONL line content — only path and byte offset.
Define and document the exact JSON schema for /api/agents and /api/sessions. Schema is the enforceable T1 boundary.
Confirm polling interval is configurable with documented default (suggested: 60s).
Auth token decision must be a named decision in the SPEC.md approval gate.
